visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two adult males sit at a dark circular table in a studio with a black mesh wall background and a large orange neon 'X'. The muscular man on the right, heavily tattooed, presses his hand firmly onto the forehead of the curly-haired man on the left. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit gym interior where the curly-haired man, in a brown tank top, is crouched and reacting to being physically slapped. His expressions are distressed and submissive as he flinches from the impacts. (3) Returning to the table, the muscular man stands and aggressively pulls the curly-haired man up by his collar, bringing their faces very close. The lighting is warm and dramatic, highlighting their tense facial expressions. (4) The curly-haired man pushes the muscular man back into his seat and stands up to explain himself, gesturing broadly with his hands. The camera captures them in a medium shot showing their upper bodies and the gym-like setting in the distance. (5) Both men sit back down and look down somberly at a smartphone resting on the table. Their aggression has subsided, replaced by a shared focus on the device as the lighting remains low and intimate.
